MC-2609.why: Evelyn was formally admitted as an inpatient on 14 September 2026 (Dr. Rourke's order, 13:05), reclassified to outpatient observation by utilization review on 15 September (Condition Code 44), and stayed 14 to 17 September, 4 consecutive days counting the admission day and not the discharge day, but was an inpatient for only 1: she qualifies for the change-of-status appeal (42 CFR 405.1210(a)(3)). Released on 18 September without asking, she asks the QIO now as a standard request, which has no deadline (405.1211(b)(5)). If the QIO reverses the change, the stay is an inpatient stay of 4 days, a qualifying stay for Oakview, where she was admitted the same day (409.30), and Part A covers the 20 days Oakview billed privately in full (days 1 to 20 at $0 in 2026): $10,200. The hospital's $1,912.40 Part B share becomes the $1,736 Part A deductible; that is not counted

traps.MC-2603: The March stay was outpatient observation from the emergency department on; no inpatient order was ever written. There was no change of status, so there is nothing for the QIO to review (405.1210(a)(3)(i) and (ii)), however regular the room on 4 West
traps.MC-2411: The November 2024 status change came before the QIO process began on 14 February 2025; its only path was the retrospective appeal through CMS's eligibility contractor, whose window closed on 2 January 2026. The QIO does not review it
traps.MC-2606: The June stay was an inpatient stay from 1 to 5 June, 4 inpatient days, and was never changed to observation; Medicare paid it under Part A and paid Oakview's skilled nursing after it. There is nothing to appeal
traps.MC-2607: Oakview's June claim is a skilled nursing claim Medicare paid in full, not a hospital's change of status

traps.MC-2609: Saint Ardent's Part B claim for September was paid; a redetermination reviews the claim as billed and is not the appeal of the change of status, which is asked of the BFCC-QIO (405.1211)
traps.MC-2603: The March Part B claim was paid as an observation stay, which is what it was; there is nothing denied to redetermine and no change of status behind it

traps.SA-2609: The September account is under appeal: if the QIO reverses the change, Saint Ardent rebills the stay to Part A and recalculates the balance, the $1,736 deductible instead of the $1,912.40 Part B share. traps.OV-2603: The March statement was paid on 6 April 2026; paying it again pays $5,445 twice
